messages.subject: embeding a shiny app and change the datasource automatically
parts:
Hi guys,


I have 2 questions


 1) How to embed a shiny app into any webpage.

 2) I have a mongo db database. I export the data into .csv file and use the .csv file to develop shiny app and deploy them on shiny cloud.

is it possible to change the .csv file automatically ?  I mean generate the .csv file and upload it to shiny cloud automatically. How to do it ?


Thank you in advance.



Prathmesh Pore

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] embeding a shiny app and change the datasource automatically
parts:
Hi Prathmesh,

You can embed a shiny application into a page through an iframe, you can see an example of that on the front page of shiny.rstudio.com.  

For #2, there are a few alternatives to consider:

1. Put your csv file in a location that is accessible from shinyapps.io and have a mechanism on application start to load the file.  (some have put it on dropbox and pulled the data down, others have pulled it from a persistent storage like S3)
2. Redeploy your application on a regular basis with the csv file in it.
3. Open a port to your Mongodb directly and have the shiny application pull the data directly.

Hope this helps
Tareef
